testcase.name: rows follow the contract, are written at full precision and carry the available-context flags
no truth, split or label field is ever written, and absent functions get no negative rows
without a model there is no model block; with a model rows carry its identity and the same score the stage uses
export and the stage use the same extractor: the vectors have identical digests
invalid context fails the export instead of writing a non-finite value
exportToDirectory writes rows, the matching contract file and a manifest whose hash matches
streaming: many rows are written without materialising them
the committed export fixture matches what the exporter writes (the Python trainer reads it)
the committed scored export fixture (mechanism logistic model) matches, so Python can check margins against the JVM
